[Sir](/person/712)
[The Child’s Christian Year](/organisation/186) is a compilation of many different poems by numerous authors

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: William Garrett Horder was the compiler of a large number of hymnals from the late 1870s onwards, so that it is hard to identify the particular book referred to in these three letters.

It could however be The Book of Praise for Children (1878).
